message: HOLD — 2 critical error(s) found. Correct before shipping.

critical_errors.description: Apostille must be issued by the Secretary of State in the SAME STATE where the document was originally issued or notarized. A California birth certificate cannot be apostilled by Texas.
critical_errors.check: Submitted to the CORRECT Secretary of State (same state as issuance/notarization)
critical_errors.notes: CA birth certificate submitted to TX Secretary of State

critical_errors.description: If the notary's commission was expired at the time they notarized the document, the apostille will be rejected. Check notary expiration date against the notarization date.
critical_errors.check: Notary commission NOT expired at time of notarization
critical_errors.notes: Notary commission expired 3 months before notarization date
